picks.title: Making an 11-minute animated short using AI exposed serious creative limits
picks.excerpt: Guillermo Miranda and Javier de la Chica open up about what AI still can't do and the unease it creates.
picks.rationale: Fresh (09-29) first-hand craft account from two animators of what AI could and could not do on an 11-minute Don Quixote short. Actionable limits for filmmakers, and a different article from the Creative Bloq 'viral AI animation' piece that ran in design on 09-29.

picks.title: Introducing Agent Tagging | Runway
picks.excerpt: Tag Runway Agent anywhere your assets are to ask for edits, options and fixes. It's that easy.Try Runway: app.runway.comSubscribe: https://youtube.com/runway...
picks.rationale: New Runway feature released 09-29: you tag the agent on an asset to ask for edits, options or fixes, which changes day-to-day workflow. This is not the Resolve plugin (09-24) or Diffuse (09-26), and there is no earlier Agent Tagging card.

picks.title: 'The Gifted' Wins Inaugural Future Vision XPRIZE
picks.excerpt: The competition is backed by Range Media Partners & Google.
picks.rationale: Fresh industry milestone: the first winner of an AI-film XPRIZE backed by Google and Range Media. It has not been covered before and is the section's single Deadline pick.

picks.title: The Best AI Workflow for a 2D + Live Action Film
picks.excerpt: In this tutorial, we teamed up with our AI Animation Instructor, @albertbozesan to show you the latest AI workflow for combining 2D animation with live-actio...
picks.rationale: A hands-on tutorial on combining 2D animation with live action using AI. It is new and differs from Curious Refuge's greybox (09-24) and Astra editing (09-28) cards, so readers can apply it right away.

picks.title: ‘스틸레이’, 기획부터 후반작업까지 100% AI…10월 극장 개봉
picks.excerpt: 100% AI 기술로 완성된 SF 액션 ‘스틸레이’가 포스터를 공개하며 10월 극장 개봉을 예고했다. ‘스틸레이’(감독 설우인ㅣ기획/제작 ㈜라온컴퍼니플러스ㅣ공동제작 ㈜아이노스튜디오)는 폭주한 AI로부터 인류를 구하기 위해 자신이 만든 AI와 아버지가 남긴 전투 수트를 활용해 최악의 바이러스에 맞서는 이야기를 그린다.
picks.rationale: A Korean feature made 100% with AI, from planning through post, gets an October theatrical release. It is a different film and studio from the 09-27 '수호도사' 4DX card (Mooam) and has not been covered before. It also gives the section a Korean-outlet angle.
